purpose.role: Medical imaging domain: tissue margin stability, SNR, imaging capacity, and contrast resolution regime diagnostics via Domain Overlay translation
purpose.description: Radiology provides the domain translation table, regime vocabulary, and domain-native signal labels for medical imaging diagnostics within the S3 Spine Domain Overlay. It maps structural faultlines to tissue margin instabilities, drift vectors to signal-to-noise ratio degradation, substrate capacity to imaging throughput, and coherence to contrast resolution quality. The DDR produced via Radiology translation is formatted as a clinical imaging regime diagnostic report.
